title: Discovery map: pwmd runtime log verbosity/focus control RPC
digest: Axum router in api/router.rs with CORS layer; logging via static EnvFilter in logging.rs (no reload support); dev_profile gating pattern exists; recommended /v1/operator/log/* endpoints with loopback/admin auth

router_construction.function: pub fn router(app: App, cors: CorsLayer) -> Router

dev_endpoint_gating.note: dev_profile is derived from network_id.starts_with('dev') in bootstrap.rs

cors_setup.function: pub fn cors_for_listen(listen: SocketAddr) -> Result<CorsLayer, String>
cors_setup.behavior: Permissive CORS for loopback; PWM_CORS_ORIGINS env required for non-loopback

init_function.function: pub fn init_logging(cfg: &LoggingConfig, console_is_tty: bool, runtime_node_id: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String>
init_function.note: Called once at startup; no runtime reload mechanism currently

filter_construction.limitation: Static filter created once at init; no reload support

log_targets_observed: pwmd::peer - peer transport, handshake, sync messages
default - seal loop, API handlers, other components

sink_architecture.console: stdout (INFO+) + stderr (WARN+); filtered to exclude peer targets
sink_architecture.main_file: Rotating file sink; filtered to exclude peer targets
sink_architecture.peer_file: Separate rotating file sink; includes only peer targets

current_limitations.no_reloadable_filter: EnvFilter is created once in init_logging() and moved into tracing_subscriber::registry().with(filter). There is no Reloadable layer or handle stored.
current_limitations.no_runtime_log_state: App struct (state.rs) has no fields for log verbosity overrides or operator focus settings.
current_limitations.no_admin_auth_pattern: No Bearer token, API key, or admin authentication pattern exists. Only dev_profile boolean gating is used.
current_limitations.static_subscriber: tracing_subscriber::registry().init() can only be called once; runtime filter changes require Reloadable or reinit (not currently implemented).
current_limitations.RUST_LOG_only: Current approach relies on RUST_LOG env var at startup; no runtime API to adjust.

endpoints.response: 200 OK with current override state, or 401/403 for auth failure

endpoints.description: Get current log override state (if any)
Clear log override and restore baseline immediately

auth_gating.secondary: Optional admin token via PWM_ADMIN_TOKEN env var, checked via Authorization: Bearer header
auth_gating.restriction: Non-loopback without admin token must reject with 403 Forbidden

focus_mapping.seal: module_path filter for seal loop components

recommended_spec.audit_requirement: All override changes (set/clear/expire) must log via info! with target 'pwmd::operator' including remote addr, old level, new level, focus, ttl

tracing_reload.code_pattern: let (filter, reload_handle) = tracing_subscriber::reload::Layer::new(filter); store handle in App

app_state_extension.new_struct: LogOverrideState { level: String, focus: String, expires_at: Instant, set_by: SocketAddr }

ttl_mechanism.approach: Store expiration Instant in LogOverrideState; spawn tokio task that sleeps until expiry then restores baseline
ttl_mechanism.race_safety: Use Arc<RwLock> compare-and-swap to ensure only the correct TTL task clears its own override

handler_module.common_checks: Extract to api/common.rs: check_operator_auth(app, req_headers, remote_addr) -> Result<(), AuthError>

minimal_first_slice.scope: Loopback-only gating, single global level override (no focus yet), 300s TTL with restore
minimal_first_slice.excludes: Complex focus filtering, peer log routing changes, persistent override across restarts

unit_tests: EnvFilter reload roundtrip: set trace, verify filter change, restore info
TTL expiration: set 5s TTL, verify auto-restore fires correctly
Auth rejection: non-loopback without token gets 403
integration: Verify override applies to subsequent peer sync messages (visible in logs)
Verify audit log entries appear in main log sink
Verify TTL restore emits final audit log entry

security: Unauthorized remote log control could expose sensitive data or facilitate DoS via log volume
Mitigation: Loopback-only default + optional admin token; reject non-loopback without auth
log_volume: Trace level on busy transports can generate GBs of logs quickly
Mitigation: Hard TTL cap (3600s max), default 300s, peer logs already separate sink
race_conditions: Concurrent override set/reset could leave stale filter state
Mitigation: Use Arc<RwLock> with explicit compare-and-swap, audit log all transitions
windows_process: Windows may have different TTY detection for console color; ensure NO_COLOR is still respected
subscriber_reinit: Cannot reinit tracing_subscriber; reload handle is the only safe mutation path
Mitigation: Use reload::Layer pattern, never call tracing_subscriber::registry().init() twice
consensus_impact: Log changes must never alter wire format, handshake semantics, or seal timing
Mitigation: Keep logging pure side-effect only; verify via code review that no logic branches on log level

additional_context.api_v1_classification: Operator endpoints are explicitly outside public stable contract per docs/api-v1.md §3.2
additional_context.dev_profile_pattern: Existing pattern in handlers_peer.rs: check a.dev_profile for dev-only endpoints
